body:
What does life mean to you?

Is it getting a smile, cry whenever you want?

Is it getting good marks in studies?

Is it getting a good job?

Is it having a good parents?

Is it getting married to a good girl?

Is it getting wonderful children?

Is it having a beautiful house?

It is being wanted by someone and

It is being want of someone . . .

That’s Life . . .

Begin searching the people . . .

Who wants you and

Whom do you want . . .

Your Life . . .


You only have to live it ! ! !

-Vijay

-4 August 2015
